annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153, 2023/1525 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.summary_en: Commission proposal for a "mini-omnibus" regulation amending six EU funding regulations to channel EU budget and cohesion resources into defence and dual-use technologies under the ReArm Europe Plan, adding defence as a fourth STEP sector. AI Gigafactories and drones are mentioned as funded areas; no AI safety governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds 'defence technologies' as a fourth strategic sector in the STEP Regulation (EU) 2024/795.
Opens the EIC Accelerator to dual-use and defence applications, derogating from Horizon Europe's civil-only principle.
Allows transfers of cohesion funds to the EDF and ASAP, and extends ASAP until 31 December 2026.
Extends Digital Europe and CEF objectives to AI Factories and Gigafactories, including for defence uses.
Offers up to 100% co-financing and 30% pre-financing for military mobility corridors under CEF.
